stem: What is the imaginary part of the complex number $z = {=a} {=s} {=c}i$?
solution: A complex number is written $a + bi$, where $a$ and $b$ are real numbers.
The imaginary part is the real coefficient of $i$, written without the $i$.

proposed_misconceptions.label: Gives the real part as the imaginary part
proposed_misconceptions.description: The student answers with a, the real part, when asked for the imaginary part of a + bi.

notes: Basic: identify the imaginary part of a + bi with b of either sign. Distractors: bi form (catalogued), real part swapped, sign flipped. a != |b| keeps options distinct; |b| >= 2.
